scene amimakesyoudinner1
I love my niece.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女。

lines.en: She’s the only thing I’ll ever need.
lines.zh: 她是我此生唯一需要的东西。

lines.en: When I’m with her, I feel happy. And when I’m not with her, I can’t stop thinking about her.
lines.zh: 和她在一起时,我感到幸福。不在一起时,我满脑子都是她。

lines.en: It doesn’t matter if she wants me all to herself. Or that she fights away anyone else who wants to see me.
lines.zh: 她想独占我,无关紧要。她赶走所有想见我的人,也无关紧要。

lines.en: She’s doing it all for good reason — because she needs me in order to function.
lines.zh: 她做这一切都有充分的理由——因为她需要我才能正常运转。

lines.en: It’s the same way I feel about her.
lines.zh: 我对她也是一模一样的感觉。

lines.en: If that’s not true love, I don’t know what is.
lines.zh: 如果这都不算真爱,我不知道什么才算。

lines.en: She’s such a good girl.
lines.zh: 她真是个好女孩。

lines.en: If she cut her finger slicing carrots, I would put it in my mouth and suck on it until the blood clotted.
lines.zh: 要是她切胡萝卜时割伤了手指,我会把那根手指含进嘴里,一直吮到血凝固。

lines.en: If I watched her empty rat poison into my supper, I would still eat it because I know she’d never do anything to hurt me and that it’s probably just for flavor.
lines.zh: 要是她当着我的面把老鼠药倒进我的晚饭,我也会照吃不误——因为我知道她绝不会伤害我,那多半只是提味的。

lines.en: You have no idea how much I love my niece.
lines.zh: 你根本无法想象我有多爱我的侄女。

lines.en: You have no idea how much she loves me.
lines.zh: 你也根本无法想象她有多爱我。

lines.en: No one can and no one ever will.
lines.zh: 没有人能想象,永远都不会有人能。

lines.en: The Ami scene will begin now.
lines.zh: Ami 场景,现在开始。

lines.en: : What do you think you’re doing?! I told you I don’t need any help!
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己在干什么?!我都说了我不需要帮忙!

lines.en: : Who says I’m helping and not just standing around? This is my house and I’m allowed to stand wherever I want.
lines.zh: : 谁说我在帮忙?我只是在随便站着。这是我的房子,我爱站哪站哪。

lines.en: : It’s my house too, mister. And if I say you’re getting in the way, it means you’re getting in the way!
lines.zh: : 这也是我的房子,先生。我要是说你碍事了,那就是你碍事了!

lines.en: : Are you trying to tell me you don’t care about my company anymore?
lines.zh: : 你是想说,你已经不在乎有没有我陪了吗?

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner2
: No. I’m trying to tell you that tonight’s dinner is a surprise and that you’re going to ruin it if you keep watching me.
lines.zh: : 不是。我是想说今晚的晚餐是个惊喜,你要是继续盯着我,惊喜就要被你毁了。

lines.en: : It’s not much of a surprise if you’re going to be waving the cookbook around in front of my face like that.
lines.zh: : 你都把菜谱在我面前晃来晃去了,这还算什么惊喜。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner3
: Hey! Stop looking and go sit down! I’m doing this for you, you big meanie!
lines.zh: : 喂!别看了,坐下等着去!我这是为你做的,你这个大坏蛋!

lines.en: : You’re absolutely sure you don’t want any help? I know I’m normally useless, but I can at least mix stuff if I try hard enough.
lines.zh: : 你确定不需要帮忙?我知道我平时一无是处,但只要我认真,至少能帮忙搅搅东西。

lines.en: : And surprises aren’t really my thing in general, so if that’s what’s keeping you from-
lines.zh: : 而且惊喜这种事本来就不对我的胃口,要是这就是你拦着我的原因——

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner4
: I’m fine. I’m sure you had a long day and that you want to relax now. There’s no need for you to interfere with my job when I never interfere with yours.
lines.zh: : 我没事。你忙了一天,肯定想歇着。我从来不打扰你的工作,你也别来打扰我的。

lines.en: : To be fair, I’m not so sure your intellect would allow you to effectively interfere with my job. Leave things like that to Makoto.
lines.zh: : 公平地说,以你的智商,我怀疑你根本没能力有效地打扰我的工作。那种事就交给 Makoto 吧。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner2
: You shut your mouth or I really will pour rat poison into your dinner.
lines.zh: : 你再不闭嘴,我真的会把老鼠药倒进你的晚饭里。

lines.en: scene black
I love my niece.
lines.zh: 我爱我的侄女。

lines.en: She reminds me a lot of someone else I used to know.
lines.zh: 她让我想起另一个我曾经认识的人。

lines.en: It’s someone I try not to think about because it hurts when I do.
lines.zh: 那是一个我尽量不去想的人,因为一想就痛。

lines.en: But it hurts even more to not think about her.
lines.zh: 但不去想她,痛得更厉害。

lines.en: Damned either way, I blank everything out and take a seat at the living room table.
lines.zh: 横竖都是死路,我干脆屏蔽一切,在客厅的桌边坐下。

lines.en: I eagerly await the dinner my wonderful niece is making me.
lines.zh: 我满心期待着我那了不起的侄女为我准备的晚餐。

lines.en: I’m sure it will be delicious because she understands the things I like and the textures and the colors and the food and the food and niece and did I mention I love her?
lines.zh: 我确信它会很好吃,因为她懂得我喜欢的东西、质感、颜色、食物、食物、侄女,还有我提过我爱她吗?

lines.en: I love her so much.
lines.zh: 我太爱她了。

lines.en: My niece, I mean.
lines.zh: 我说的是我的侄女。

lines.en: Not the other person I mentioned a moment ago because she isn’t real and you can’t love what isn’t real and oh look Ami is back.
lines.zh: 不是刚才提到的另一个人,因为她不是真实存在的,而人不可能爱上不存在的东西——哦看,Ami 回来了。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner5
: Curry?
lines.zh: : 咖喱?

lines.en: : And lots of it. Good thing we bought that second rice pot, right?
lines.zh: : 而且是超大量。还好我们买了第二个电饭煲,对吧?

lines.en: : Ami, this is too much food.
lines.zh: : Ami,这也太多了。

lines.en: : Then we’ll have leftovers. Who cares? Curry is always better on the second day anyway.
lines.zh: : 那就剩着呗。谁在乎?咖喱这种东西,第二天的才更香。

lines.en: : Fair enough. Is this really so special that I had to step away from the kitchen, though? Anyone can make curry.
lines.zh: : 也对。不过这真的特别到我必须离开厨房的地步吗?咖喱谁都会做。

lines.en: : This isn’t just any curry, Sensei. It’s Ami’s special curry — made with real Ami.
lines.zh: : 这可不是普通的咖喱,Sensei。这是 Ami 特制咖喱——用真正的 Ami 做的。

lines.en: : Real Ami?
lines.zh: : 真正的 Ami?

lines.en: : It’s full of my blood. I used it in place of salt. I hope you like it.
lines.zh: : 我往里面加了我的血。用血代替了盐。希望你喜欢。

lines.en: : As long as it’s not rat poison.
lines.zh: : 只要不是老鼠药就行。

lines.en: I spoon a spoonful of curry into my spoon and then spoon it into my mouth. I can’t even taste the blood.
lines.zh: 我用勺子舀起一勺咖喱,再把它送进嘴里。我甚至尝不出血的味道。

lines.en: Ami’s special curry is way better than anything you can buy from the store and I’m glad she made it for me tonight.
lines.zh: Ami 特制咖喱比店里能买到的任何东西都好吃,我很高兴她今晚为我做了这个。

lines.en: : I love your blood.
lines.zh: : 我爱你的血。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner6
: Thanks! I love it too.
lines.zh: : 谢谢!我也爱它。

lines.en: : I was just kidding, though. This is normal curry without any Ami in it. But I’m glad to know you would have eaten it if there was!
lines.zh: : 不过刚才是开玩笑。这就是普通的咖喱,里面一点 Ami 都没有。但知道你就算是加了也会吃,我还是很开心!

lines.en: : If there is no Ami in the curry how can it be called Ami’s special curry?
lines.zh: : 咖喱里要是没有 Ami,那怎么能叫 Ami 特制咖喱?

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner7
: It’s special because it’s rare!
lines.zh: : 它特制就特制在罕见!

lines.en: : I’ve only made it a few times since I started high school. Which means you should savor it since you have no idea when the next time you’ll get any is.
lines.zh: : 上了高中以后我只做过几次。所以你应该细细品味,因为你完全不知道下一次能吃到是什么时候。

lines.en: : Probably the next time I ask. I can’t imagine a world where you’d ever say no to something I want.
lines.zh: : 大概就是下一次我开口的时候吧。我无法想象一个你会在我的请求面前说「不」的世界。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner8
: Nuh-uh. There are plenty of things I’d say no to. You just don’t normally ask for any of them because you love me so much. Right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 才没有的事。我有很多事会说「不」。只是你平时根本不会提那些,因为你太爱我了。对吧,Sensei?

lines.en: : Yes.
I love my niece so much that I am not opposed to consuming her bodily fluids when she uses them to cook.
lines.zh: 我太爱我的侄女了,以至于当她用自己的体液做饭时,我完全不介意把它们喝下去。

lines.en: I am also not opposed to consuming her and if she shrunk herself down to the size of a pill I would take her with a glass of water, swallow her, and allow her to expand in size inside of me.
lines.zh: 我同样不介意把她本身吃掉——要是她把自己缩成药丸那么大,我会就着一杯水把她吞下去,任她在我体内重新舒展开来。

lines.en: You have no idea how much I love my niece.
lines.zh: 你根本无法想象我有多爱我的侄女。

lines.en: : Thank you, thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,谢谢。

lines.en: : It’s always so much fun whenever you think out loud. You don’t share your feelings enough and hearing them straight from the source is like heroin for me!
lines.zh: : 你每次自言自语把心里话说出来,都特别有意思。你分享感情的频率太低了,直接听你亲口说,对我来说简直像海洛因!

lines.en: : But of course, I say that as a good girl who has never done and never will do drugs. Because the only drug I need is you.
lines.zh: : 当然,说这话的是一个从未碰过、也永远不会碰毒品的好女孩。因为我唯一需要的毒品,就是你。

lines.en: Awwwwww.
lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦~

lines.en: : Teehee!
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻!

lines.en: : You’re lucky I don’t take real advantage of you when you’re like this, Sensei. It would be so easy.
lines.zh: : 你运气好,你这样的时候,我可没有趁机真占你便宜,Sensei。那简直易如反掌。

lines.en: : Like what? What am I doing wrong?
lines.zh: : 比如什么?我到底做错了什么?

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner9
: You’re not doing anything wrong. You’re just probably not doing what you think you’re doing.
lines.zh: : 你没做错什么。你只是大概率没在做你以为自己在做的事。

lines.en: : There’s a disconnect between your mind and what’s actually happening that makes things seem normal to you when they’re not like, actually normal.
lines.zh: : 你的大脑和实际发生的事之间断开了连接,让一切在你眼里显得正常——虽然实际上并不正常。

lines.en: : It’s a coping thingy.
lines.zh: : 这是某种自我保护机制之类的。

lines.en: : For example, you’re totally naked right now and you probably didn’t even realize.
lines.zh: : 举个例子,你现在全裸,而你自己多半都没意识到。

lines.en: I look down and confirm that I am, in fact, naked.
lines.zh: 我低头一看,确认自己确实一丝不挂。

lines.en: Whoopsie.
lines.zh: 哎呀。

lines.en: : That’s so weird. Most of my thoughts are entirely coherent right now.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。我大部分念头现在都还挺连贯的。

lines.en: : There have been plenty of times where I’ve blacked out, but this is kind of like a halfway point where I’m still sentient.
lines.zh: : 我有过很多次断片,但这算是中间态——人还清醒着。

lines.en: : How curious.
lines.zh: : 有趣。

lines.en: : It’s probably because of what I mentioned earlier.
lines.zh: : 多半是因为我之前提到的那件事。

lines.en: : What did you mention earlier?
lines.zh: : 你之前提到什么了?

lines.en: : My parents.
lines.zh: : 我的父母。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner10
: I said something in passing about how you’ve slipped into the dad role perfectly and I guess your brain just kinda kicked itself into self-defense mode.
lines.zh: : 我刚刚顺嘴说了句,说你完美地补上了「爸爸」的位置——我猜你的大脑就自己切入了自我保护模式。

lines.en: : It’s my fault for letting it slip. I understand by now that this can happen since the same thing happens to me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 让那句话说出口是我的错。我现在明白了这种事会发生,因为我自己有时也会这样。

lines.en: : It’s true, though. And there’s no harm in saying that now since you’re already like this.
lines.zh: : 但我说的是真的。而且你都进入这个状态了,现在说出来也无妨。

lines.en: : I don’t want to say you’re more of a dad to me than my real dad ever was, but I definitely like you more.
lines.zh: : 我不想说你比我亲爸更像我的爸爸,但我确实更喜欢你不止一点。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner11
: Granted, I was always more of a mama’s girl in the first place.
lines.zh: : 话说回来,我本来就更偏向妈妈那边的。

lines.en: : I didn’t dislike my dad or anything. He was totally...normal.
lines.zh: : 我并不是不喜欢我爸什么的。他完全……正常。

lines.en: : But next to Mom, he just...
lines.zh: : 但站在妈妈身边,他就……

lines.en: : No one could ever look good next to her. It wasn’t his fault.
lines.zh: : 站在她身边,没有人能显得出色。那不是他的错。

lines.en: : She was beautiful. Creative. Funny. Smart.
lines.zh: : 她那么美。那么有创造力。那么风趣。那么聪明。

lines.en: : And the way she treated me...
lines.zh: : 还有她对我的态度……

lines.en: : It was like nothing else mattered to her.
lines.zh: : 仿佛世界上其他一切都不重要。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner12
: Sorry. I know I’m getting emotional when we haven’t even started eating yet, but...
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我知道我们连饭都还没开始吃,我就情绪上来了,但是……

lines.en: : Honestly, my mind’s been kind of all over the place lately.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我最近脑子有点乱。

lines.en: : What with those standardized test thingies and...with Maya and Ayane starting to...treat me like I’m some kind of...
lines.zh: : 一方面是那些模拟考什么的,一方面 Maya 和 Ayane 最近开始……把我当成某种……

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner13
: Never mind. We don’t have to get into that right now. I’m more interested in hearing what you have to say about my parents.
lines.zh: : 算了。这个我们不用现在聊。我更想听听你对我父母的事要说什么。

lines.en: : You miss them too, right?
lines.zh: : 你也想念他们,对吧?

lines.en: : Of course you do...How could you not when you were hit just as hard by their passing as me?
lines.zh: : 你当然会……他们离世对你的打击和我一样重,你怎么可能不想念?

lines.en: : But it’s fine. Well...no. It’s not fine. Nothing like that can ever be fine.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系的。嗯……不。不是没关系。这种事永远不可能「没关系」。

lines.en: : But they’re in a better place now. Or at least I hope they are.
lines.zh: : 但他们现在去了更好的地方。至少我希望是。

lines.en: : I know Mom never believed in God.
lines.zh: : 我知道妈妈从来不信神。

lines.en: : She pretended to around me because it was the “right” thing to do, but even when I was little, I could tell she was just going along with it for my sake.
lines.zh: : 她在我面前装作信,因为那是「正确」的做法,但我从小就看得出来,她只是配合我而已。

lines.en: : You feel the same as her, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你和她想的一样,对吧?

lines.en: : That there is no afterlife. Or reincarnation. Or...anything at all.
lines.zh: : 没有来世。没有转生。也……没有任何东西。

lines.en: : I don’t like that.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : I can’t stand the idea of the two of them just...covered in dirt for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 我受不了他们俩就这么……永远埋在土里的画面。

lines.en: : I want them to go somewhere else. And I want to go somewhere else when I die too.
lines.zh: : 我希望他们去了别的地方。也希望我死的时候,也能去别的地方。

lines.en: : I know you loved her, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我知道你爱她,Sensei。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner14
: And I’m not just saying that because everybody loved her. I know she was important to you in a way my dad never was.
lines.zh: : 我不是随大流才这么说的。我知道她对你的重要性,是我爸从来不曾企及的。

lines.en: : And even if you and him never saw eye to eye on stuff, I know you must at least kind of miss him too.
lines.zh: : 就算你们俩从来话不投机,我也知道你至少有几分想念他。

lines.en: : But he’d be proud of you if he could see you now. And so would my mom.
lines.zh: : 但如果他能看到今天的你,他会为你骄傲的。我妈妈也会。

lines.en: : You’re doing an amazing job. We both are.
lines.zh: : 你做得非常出色。我们都是。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner15
: Which is why I’m going to try harder to be like her.
lines.zh: : 所以我会更加努力,变得更像她。

lines.en: : To be someone everyone loves and admires. But, more importantly than that...
lines.zh: : 成为一个所有人爱戴和敬佩的人。但比这更重要的是……

lines.en: : To be someone you love and admire. Because what you think matters more to me than every other thought in every other world squished into one giant ball.
lines.zh: : 成为一个你爱戴和敬佩的人。因为你的想法对我的意义,比其他所有世界里所有其他念头揉成的一个巨大球体加起来还要重。

lines.en: : You don’t want that.
lines.zh: : 你不会想要那个的。

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner16
: Huh?
: You don’t...
lines.zh: : 你不会……

lines.en: : Want...to...
: Don’t...
lines.zh: : 不要……

lines.en: : Why not? Why would I not aspire to be someone that important to you? And don’t go saying it’s because you already love me a lot since we both know you can always love me more.
lines.zh: : 为什么?我为什么不能立志成为对你那么重要的人?而且不许说什么「因为我已经够爱你了」,我们都知道,你永远可以更爱我一点。

lines.en: I reach into the back of my mind, unsure of whether or not I’ll be able to latch onto anything and, if I do, if Ami will be able to catch a glimpse of it.
lines.zh: 我探向记忆的深处,不确定自己能不能抓住什么东西——就算抓住了,Ami 能不能瞥见它。

lines.en: She’s seen almost everything so far. The things I thought were private wound up not being private at all.
lines.zh: 到目前为止,她几乎已经看过我的一切。我原以为私密的东西,结果根本谈不上私密。

lines.en: I do not know the shape I’m in or the state of my mind. But as someone so accustomed to seeing me this way and at least attempting to fix me up, I hope she’ll understand.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己现在的形状,也不知道自己神志的状态。但作为一个早就习惯看到我这副模样、并且至少会尝试把我修好的人,我希望她能理解。

lines.en: Goodbye thoughts of blood...dismembered carrots.
lines.zh: 再见了,血的念头……被肢解的胡萝卜。

lines.en: Goodbye colors, textures, wan’dring rabbits.
lines.zh: 再见了,颜色、质感、游荡的兔子。

lines.en: In this desperate plea for a voice to speak I clap my hands and stomp my feet but it’s not a tantrum I repeat I’m doing this because I’m weak my throat is hoarse from lack of sleep and this run on sentence hurts to read but-
lines.zh: 在这场求一个声音开口的绝望恳求里我拍着手跺着脚但这不是发脾气我重申我这么做是因为我虚弱缺乏睡眠让我的喉咙沙哑而这个长句读起来让人头疼但是——

lines.en: I can not punctuate something that is meant to look broken.
lines.zh: 我无法给一件本就该看起来破碎的东西加上标点。

lines.en: And I can not place a period in a sentence that is never meant to end.
lines.zh: 我也无法给一个本就永远不该结束的句子画上句号。

lines.en: All I can do is split myself open and hope that some of my guts spill onto Ami.
lines.zh: 我能做的,只有把自己剖开,盼望有一部分内脏溅落在 Ami 身上。

lines.en: She’s chasing after something she doesn’t want to find.
lines.zh: 她正在追逐一件她并不想找到的东西。

lines.en: And should she ever spot a period...or another ending mark-
lines.zh: 而万一她哪天看到了一个句号……或别的什么终结符——

lines.en: I pray she just ignores it.
lines.zh: 我祈祷她直接无视它。

lines.en: Thus begins another arc.
lines.zh: 于是,新的篇章开始了。

lines.en: : She...
: You...
scene amimakesyoudinner17
: Uhh...l...let’s move on!
lines.zh: : 呃……我……我们换个话题!

lines.en: : We should talk more about how...uhh...
lines.zh: : 我们该多聊聊……呃……

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner18
: Uhh...

lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner19
: Right! Maya and Ayane have been really mean to me lately! Do you want to hear more about that?
lines.zh: : 对了!Maya 和 Ayane 最近对我特别坏!你想听听细节吗?

lines.en: scene happy1
scene happy2
scene amimakesyoudinner20
: Sure.
lines.zh: : 好啊。

lines.en: : Are you crying?
lines.zh: : 你在哭吗?

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner21
: What do you mean “Am I crying?!” Things just got really intense and sad all of a sudden and now you’re just going back to normal?! What the heck?!
lines.zh: : 什么叫「我在哭吗?!」气氛刚刚突然变得又沉重又悲伤,结果你转头就恢复正常了?!搞什么?!

lines.en: : What are you talking about? And why am I naked?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么?还有我为什么是裸的?

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner22
: You’re naked because you have a problem! And only I know how to take care of it! Okay?!
lines.zh: : 你裸着是因为你有一个大问题!而且只有我知道怎么照顾它!好吗?!

lines.en: : A problem? Are you talking about-
lines.zh: : 大问题?你是说——

lines.en: : Maya and Ayane are trying to get rid of me!
lines.zh: : Maya 和 Ayane 想甩掉我!

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : What do you mean they’re trying to get rid of you?
lines.zh: : 「甩掉你」是什么意思?

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner23
: I mean they’ve been hanging out without me and...excluding me from stuff and...it’s kind of like they don’t want to be my friends anymore.
lines.zh: : 就是她们背着我出去玩……什么活动都不带我……感觉就像她们不想再当我的朋友了。

lines.en: : It’s been really, really hurtful.
lines.zh: : 这真的、真的让人很受伤。

lines.en: : I’m just happy I have you still...I know you’d never leave me...
lines.zh: : 我只是庆幸我还有你……我知道你永远不会离开我……

lines.en: : They’re not trying to get rid of you, Ami. The two of them are just...going through something that you wouldn’t really understand.
lines.zh: : 她们没有想甩掉你,Ami。她们俩只是……正在经历一些你暂时理解不了的事。

lines.en: : Try me. I’m not as dumb as I look. Or act.
lines.zh: : 你倒试试说给我听。我没有看起来那么笨。行动上也没有。

lines.en: : I’ve been given specific instructions to not do that.
lines.zh: : 我收到了明确的指令,不能说。

lines.en: : So it is a secret after all...
lines.zh: : 所以这果然是个秘密……

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I just can’t-
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我真的不能——

lines.en: : Does it have something to do with “the end of the world?”
lines.zh: : 是不是和「世界末日」有关?

lines.en: : How do you-
lines.zh: : 你怎么会——

lines.en: : Makoto texted me about it.
lines.zh: : Makoto 发短信告诉我的。

lines.en: : Something about the world being a...loopy thing? She used a bunch of big words I didn’t really get.
lines.zh: : 说什么世界是一个……循环往复的东西?她用了一堆我听不懂的大词。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: I guess no one told Makoto to keep Ami out of this.
lines.zh: 看来没人跟 Makoto 下达过「把 Ami 排除在外」的指令。

lines.en: But, then again, I don’t really understand why we were supposed to in the first place, so...
lines.zh: 不过话说回来,我也没搞懂为什么一开始要瞒着她,所以……

lines.en: : Would you mind explaining what all of this is about, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 能麻烦你解释一下这到底是怎么回事吗,Sensei?

lines.en: : Fine.
scene amimakesyoudinner24
: Your first year of high school is never going to end.
lines.zh: : 你的高中一年级,永远不会结束。

lines.en: : You and everyone else are caught in a timeloop that causes it to start over every few months.
lines.zh: : 你和其他所有人,都困在一个时间循环里,每隔几个月,一切就会重来一遍。

lines.en: : You retain most of your memories and progress in relationships, but certain information is conveniently omitted from what you carry on from one iteration to the next.
lines.zh: : 你会保留大部分记忆和关系进度,但某些信息会被贴心地从你带入下一个循环的内容里删掉。

lines.en: : And seeing as you haven’t interjected yet, I should also inform you that if you try to talk about this to anyone else, that they’ll continuously interrupt you until you change topics.
lines.zh: : 鉴于你还没插嘴,我还应该告诉你:你要是试图跟其他任何人聊这件事,他们会不停地打断你,直到你换话题为止。

lines.en: : Also, everybody disappears, the sky turns red, and pregnancy is probably not the cause.
lines.zh: : 另外,所有人都会消失,天空会变红,而且怀孕多半不是原因。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : ...Yeah?
scene amimakesyoudinner25
: That is the dumbest thing I have ever heard.
lines.zh: : 这是我这辈子听过最蠢的话。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Did you seriously think I was going to fall for that?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我会信这个?

lines.en: : Ami, it’s not-
lines.zh: : Ami,这不是——

lines.en: : I know I said I’m not as dumb as I look, but to think you thought I was that dumb? Come on! That’s insulting!
lines.zh: : 我是说过我没有看起来那么笨,但你居然觉得我笨到这个地步?拜托!这是侮辱!

lines.en: : Also, somebody should really give Makoto the memo that this is all just a prank because it really seemed like she was taking this seriously. How can she be so smart and yet so gullible?
lines.zh: : 还有,真该有人给 Makoto 递个条子,告诉她这一切只是个恶作剧——她刚才看起来完全是认真的。她怎么能又聪明又这么好骗?

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: : Ami——

lines.en: scene amimakesyoudinner26
: Just eat your dinner, Sensei. It’s getting cold.
lines.zh: : 快吃你的晚饭吧,Sensei。要凉了。

lines.en: : And stop believing everything Maya tells you. She reads too many weird manga and they’re clearly going to her head.
lines.zh: : 还有,别什么话都信 Maya。她怪漫画看太多了,明显都看进脑子里去了。

lines.en: : It’s not just her. It’s-
lines.zh: : 不只是她。还有——

lines.en: : And stop believing everything Maya tells you. She reads too many weird manga and they’re clearly going to her head.
lines.zh: : 还有,别什么话都信 Maya。她怪漫画看太多了,明显都看进脑子里去了。

lines.en: : Ami, listen...I have seen-
lines.zh: : Ami,你听着……我亲眼见过——

lines.en: : And stop believing everything Maya tells you. She reads too many weird manga and they’re clearly going to her head.
lines.zh: : 还有,别什么话都信 Maya。她怪漫画看太多了,明显都看进脑子里去了。

lines.en: scene black
: Curry?
lines.zh: : 咖喱?

lines.en: : You never make curry.
lines.zh: : 你从来不做咖喱的。

lines.en: : It’s Ami’s special curry! Made with real Ami.
lines.zh: : 这是 Ami 特制咖喱!用真正的 Ami 做的。

lines.en: : I’m suddenly not hungry anymore.
lines.zh: : 我突然没食欲了。
